limitations: Isolated hidden window with GPU enabled and backgroundThrottling=false; not visible-window or visual-equivalence acceptance.
CPU/memory of real Provider/MCP excluded by offline adapter.
fsync/git counts cover instrumented main and Hook Node processes, not workers or shell internals.
activeRuns bytes are JSON size, not Electron wire bytes; observer serializes each actual response once.
No forced GC; post-run memory is not proof of a leak.
cpuScope: Browser + Tab + GPU + Hook Node processes; excludes git, shell internals and other separate utility/worker processes. In-process thread CPU belongs to its OS process.
sampleWindow: CPU uses 250ms samples bracketing the operation; post-run memory uses a pre-shutdown 2.0–2.8 second idle sample.
